card.summary: Ask the user a question and pause the run until they answer.

spec.description: Ask the user for information or a decision that only they can give. The run pauses until the host supplies an answer; the answer arrives as this call's result.

choices.description: Optional fixed options the user may pick from.

spec.usage_notes: Ask one question at a time. Never ask for something a tool can find out.

discovery.kernel_note: When you need information or a decision only the user can give, call meta.user.ask; the run pauses until they answer.
